translated_title: Mexico Denounces at the UN That the Blockade Against Cuba "Is Beginning to Be Measured in Lives"
original_title: México denuncia en la ONU que el bloqueo contra Cuba "comienza a medirse en vidas"
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez
meta_description: Ambassador Héctor Vasconcelos told the UN the embargo is doubling Cuba's infant mortality, and urged removing the island from Washington's terror-sponsor list.
